question: List the names of all customers.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers

question: Which products belong to the electronics category?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'electronics'

question: Show order ids together with customer names.
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

question: How many orders has each customer placed?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id

question: What is the average price of furniture products?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products WHERE category = 'furniture'

question: List product names ordered by price from high to low.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC

question: Show the two most expensive products.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 2

question: Which customers ordered more than one item line?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

question: Show customer names whose total order item quantity is at least 3.
gold_sql: WITH item_totals AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_qty FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN item_totals t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id WHERE t.total_qty >= 3

question: List all orders with their status.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, status FROM orders

question: How many customers live in Beijing?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = 'Beijing'

question: Show products never ordered by anyone.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items i ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE i.product_id IS NULL

question: What is the total revenue by product category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(p.price * i.quantity) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category

question: Show the names of customers who live in a city that does not exist in the customer table.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city = 'Nowhere'

question: List the names of all students.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students

question: Which students are in grade 11?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE grade = 11

question: Show every enrollment with the student name and course name.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, c.name FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id

question: How many students are enrolled per course?
gold_sql: SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM enrollments GROUP BY course_id

question: What is the average score across all enrollments?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(score) FROM enrollments

question: List students ordered by name.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY name

question: Show the three highest scores in the enrollments table.
gold_sql: SELECT score FROM enrollments ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which students scored above the overall average score?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE student_id IN (SELECT student_id FROM enrollments WHERE score > (SELECT AVG(score) FROM enrollments))

question: Show each student's best score.
gold_sql: WITH best AS (SELECT student_id, MAX(score) AS max_score FROM enrollments GROUP BY student_id) SELECT s.name, b.max_score FROM students s JOIN best b ON s.student_id = b.student_id

question: List all courses and their credits.
gold_sql: SELECT name, credits FROM courses

question: Which courses have at least 3 enrollments?
gold_sql: SELECT course_id FROM enrollments GROUP BY course_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3

question: Which teachers teach no course?
gold_sql: SELECT t.name FROM teachers t LEFT JOIN courses c ON t.teacher_id = c.teacher_id WHERE c.teacher_id IS NULL

question: What is the average score per grade level?
gold_sql: SELECT s.grade, AVG(e.score) AS avg_score FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.grade

question: List students who have no enrollments.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM students s LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.enrollment_id IS NULL

question: List the names of all employees.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM employees

question: Which employees earn more than 20000?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE salary > 20000

question: Show every employee with their department name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.name, d.name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id

question: How many employees work in each department?
gold_sql: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM employees GROUP BY department_id

question: What is the total budget of all projects?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(budget) FROM projects

question: List projects ordered by budget from low to high.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM projects ORDER BY budget ASC

question: Show the employee with the highest salary.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which employees work on more than one project?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM assignments GROUP BY employee_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

question: Show total hours each employee worked across projects.
gold_sql: WITH hours AS (SELECT employee_id, SUM(hours) AS total_hours FROM assignments GROUP BY employee_id) SELECT e.name, h.total_hours FROM employees e JOIN hours h ON e.employee_id = h.employee_id

question: List the names and budgets of all projects.
gold_sql: SELECT name, budget FROM projects

question: Which departments are in Beijing?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM departments WHERE city = 'Beijing'

question: Show employees who are assigned to no project.
gold_sql: SELECT e.name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN assignments a ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id WHERE a.assignment_id IS NULL

question: What is the average salary per department?
gold_sql: SELECT department_id, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department_id

question: List employees whose salary is above the company average.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees)
